sources.entry: novelWriter - Open-source plain text editor for writing novels with minimal markdown-like syntax. [![OSS][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/vkbo/novelWriter) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: novelWriter is an open-source plain text editor for writing novels assembled from many small text documents, using a minimal Markdown-inspired syntax.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes novelWriter as a plain text editor for novels built from many smaller documents. It uses a minimal formatting syntax inspired by Markdown and adds a metadata syntax for comments, synopsis, and cross-referencing. Projects are stored as human-readable text files, which the README says suits version control and file synchronisation tools. It is written in Python with a Qt6 / PyQt6 user interface and is said to run on Linux, Windows and macOS. The README points to external documentation for installation and usage rather than giving detailed instructions itself.
use_cases: Writing a novel split across many chapter or scene files
Organising notes and synopses alongside manuscript text
Keeping a writing project under git or other version control
Syncing a writing project across devices with file sync tools
Cross-referencing characters, places and other story elements
how_to_run: See the project website novelwriter.io and documentation at docs.novelwriter.io for installation and usage
Available as a package on PyPI under the name novelWriter
notable: Plain text project storage in human-readable files, suited to version control and sync tools
Minimal Markdown-inspired formatting with a metadata syntax for comments, synopsis and cross-references
Cross-platform: Linux, Windows and macOS per the README
Windows code signing provided by SignPath.io
caveats: The README gives no detailed install steps; it refers to the external website and docs
Maintainer asks that feature pull requests be discussed first and that AI-generated content not be submitted
Fixes to the current release must target the release branch; new features go to main
